description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. Make sure that the value is unique for each request. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.
The name of the source instance.

description.zh: 需要更新的插件，多个插件间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The extensions to update. Separate multiple extensions with commas (,).
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb update-extensions --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --extensions postgres_fdw --db-names auto_test_db --vpc-id vpc-bp1qpo0kug3a20qqe0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb UpdateExtensions --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 'rg-0000000000' --VpcId 'vpc-bp1qpo0kug3a20qqe0000' --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --DBNames auto_test_db --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Extensions postgres_fdw --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000
